blocks.text: Ezekiel 48 contains 35 verses. It opens with: Now these are the names of the tribes: From the north end, beside the way of Hethlon to the entrance of Hamath, Hazar-enan at the border of Damascus, northward beside Hamath, (and they shall have their sides east `and' west,) Dan, one `portion'. It concludes with: It shall be eighteen thousand `reeds' round about: and the name of the city from that day shall be, Jehovah is there.
